info.title: OxiBelt Admin API
info.description: Authenticated OxiBelt Admin API contract for control-plane automation. IPM authorization uses resource-specific Admin scopes such as cache policy/host, dynamic-policy source/name/route, upstream-pool server, stream-pool server, and typed IPM resources.

tags.name: operations
tags.description: Process-local long-running Admin operation queue, polling, and event streams.

tags.name: config
tags.description: Runtime configuration validation, diff, load, rollback, and TLS reload.

tags.name: files
tags.description: Explicit config and OxiRule file synchronization.

tags.name: cache
tags.description: Cache diagnostics, warming, and purging. Mutations check policy/<policy> and host/<normalized-host> resources.

tags.name: waf
tags.description: WAF telemetry, rulepack summaries, and OxiRule development tools.

tags.name: ipm
tags.description: Identity Permission Management reads, mutations, and authorization simulation with typed resources such as principal/<id>, credential/<id>, policy/<name>, binding/<id>, audit/current, and simulation/current.

tags.name: dynamic-policy
tags.description: Dynamic policy automation scoped by source/<source>/name/<name> and optional route/<route> resources.

tags.name: upstream-pools
tags.description: Runtime upstream-pool inspection and server control. Server snapshots include health reason, health-check time, outlier ejection, slow-start, and effective-weight fields. Server mutations check <pool>/server/<server_id> resources.

tags.name: stream-pools
tags.description: Runtime TCP/UDP stream-pool inspection and server control. Server mutations check <pool>/server/<server_id> stream-pool resources and require tcp:// or udp:// origins.

bearerAuth.description: Admin bearer token supplied by IPM credentials or bootstrap Admin token.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Active config, IPM, dynamic-policy, or upstream-pool ETag from the corresponding status endpoint.

IfMatchOptional.name: If-Match
IfMatchOptional.description: Optional ETag from the corresponding status endpoint. When supplied, it is enforced as a precondition.

AdminListLimit.name: limit
AdminListLimit.description: Enables opt-in pagination and limits the number of returned list items.

AdminListCursor.name: cursor
AdminListCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in pagination.next_cursor. The cursor is bound to the endpoint, sort, order, and filters.

AdminOperationId.name: id
AdminOperationId.description: Canonical operation ID with op_ prefix and UUIDv4 payload.

subject_type.description: Dynamic policy subject type. Hash subjects use canonical prefixes fingerprint:, binding:, clearance:, or hash: with a SHA-256 value; route variants store '<subject>|<route_name>'.

origin.description: Stream upstream origin. Must use tcp://host:port or udp://host:port.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated actor is not authorized by IPM.

Conflict.description: Request conflicts with the active store mode or static IPM bootstrap entries.

PreconditionRequired.description: A mutating request omitted the required If-Match ETag.

MethodNotAllowed.description: HTTP method is not allowed for this Admin endpoint.

InternalError.description: Internal Admin response encoding or control-plane error.

exceptions.description: Number of rulepack exception entries declared by the loaded manifest.

source_url.description: Sanitized source URL recorded when oxibeltctl installed the rulepack from a URL.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact downloaded rulepack bytes.

source_openpgp_signature_url.description: Sanitized detached OpenPGP signature URL when the signature was downloaded separately.

source_openpgp_signer_fingerprint.description: Full OpenPGP signer fingerprint that verified the downloaded rulepack.
